Matt Haig - How to Stay Alive.

It uses simple language with small chapters, so it doesn’t feel like a task in itself trying to read it. It’s written by an author who experienced depression himself, and so it’s giving that perspective to the reader while trying to open you up to the fact there is worth in your life and you are important, and allowed to feel. Highly recommend.
